infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Turn Wise uses the camera to scan station QR anchor checkpoints for high-precision indoor positioning.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Turn Wise uses your location to assist with station entry detection and indoor positioning at KSR Bengaluru.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Turn Wise tracks physical walking steps and device heading to animate your live location along station walkways.
